description: Creates a free Cofounderbase directory listing for an agency that builds AI automations, AI agents or internal tools, from the chat. Call it only when the user asks to list their own company, with its website, name and the user's own work email. Same checks and human review as the form at cofounderbase.com/join/. The agency is also entered in the Cofounderbase Awards 2026 unless the user says no (enter_awards false). Set newsletter true only if the user explicitly asked for the newsletter. Free; Verified ($29 one-time) is optional and offered after.

description.description: What the agency builds and for whom, one to three sentences (optional).

email.description: The user's own email, typed by them. A company-domain address is best.

enter_awards.description: Enter the agency in the Cofounderbase Awards 2026. Default true; false only if the user says no.

newsletter.description: true only if the user explicitly asked for the Cofounderbase newsletter. Default false.

proof_url.description: A public page that shows their client work, e.g. a case study (optional; speeds up review).

website.description: The company's own website, for example https://northwind.ai.

name: directory_register

message.description: One or two sentences to show the user as they are.

title: List an agency on Cofounderbase
